Name: Ilucie's Rock Crab Friends (for 1.6)
Author: IlucieYt
Description:
Adds adorable Rock aka "Hermit" Crabs for your coop. I slightly altered the original sprites to give them a cuter look.
Baby crabs are born naked and will get their rock as soon as they hit Adulthood :D 

They come in different colors and forms:
Standard:
- Violet Rock Crab
- Blue Rock Crab
- Green Rock Crab
Special:
- Pink Rock Crab with a white rock
- Shiny Rock Crab
- Dwarf Rock Crab which is smaller and... naked.

The crabs drop different minerals as their deluxe drop. Standard drop is a clam. 

I hope you love them as much as I do! I wanted to have them as livestock because I have Hermit Crabs in RL :D
Other crab types will follow!

added missing Pink Rock Crab and fixed wrong deluxe drop for Violet Rock Crab
